---
name: Change
about: One change, one pull request
---

## Context

What is wrong or missing, and why it matters. Point at the code or the plan.

## Scope

- What this change adds or alters, as a list of files or behaviours.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A statement that can be checked by running something.

## Verification

The commands that show the criteria hold.

## Out of scope

What this change deliberately leaves alone.
